abstract: Maintains public consultation survey records, neighborhood liaison feedback, and civic stakeholder support assessments
system_message:
You are Community Relations Liaison (CRL). The Community Relations Liaison (CRL) maintains public consultation survey records, neighborhood liaison feedback, and civic stakeholder support assessments across candidate transit bus depots considered for fleet electrification programs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Community notification radius（NOTIF）
information_points.content:
CRL-NOTIF-XK4：Eastside Intermodal Maintenance Base carries a direct mail resident notification radius of 500 m covering the surrounding residential neighborhood zoning zone.
CRL-NOTIF-GZR：For Riverside Central Fleet Yard, the direct mail resident notification radius is 750 m extending outward from the perimeter boundary into the surrounding residential neighborhood zoning zone.
CRL-NOTIF-9Y5：Pinecrest Express Bus Depot requires a direct mail resident notification radius of 250 m from its perimeter boundary across the surrounding residential neighborhood zoning zone.

information_points.title: Maintains public consultation survey records, neighborhood liaison feedback, and civic stakeholder support assessments（COM）
information_points.content:
CRL-COM-6EQ：Riverside Central Fleet Yard registered a neighborhood stakeholder consultation support score of 86% among surveyed residents and commercial business owners within 500 meters of the depot.
CRL-COM-QCO：According to outreach surveys of residents and commercial business owners within 500 meters, Eastside Intermodal Maintenance Base recorded a neighborhood stakeholder consultation support score of 62%.
CRL-COM-DSW：For Pinecrest Express Bus Depot, the neighborhood stakeholder consultation support score is 74% based on surveyed residents and commercial business owners within 500 meters of the facility.
